turns.question: What was our average basket size, in euros, in the week starting Monday 21 September 2026?
turns.answer: Average order value (EUR), the metric for basket size, was €130.28 per non-cancelled order over the seven days from 21 to 27 September 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
